data.name: Highlights of Golden Gate Park Bike Tour
data.short_name: SF: Highlights of Golden Gate Park Bike Tour
data.description:
Explore San Francisco's famous Golden Gate Park, with tons of sights and landmarks along with its beautiful bike paths! This 2-hour ride is perfect for the beginner, as they breeze past Hippie Hill, the Gardens, and other historical landmarks! Unlimited Biking will arm you with all you need for your adventure - a guide, helmet, bike bag, all free of charge – you just supply the need to explore!

We are located right outside of the park where you will meet your guide and get fitted for your bike before heading out. **Upgrade to our comfortable Cannondale eBikes and minimize the pedaling, so you can focus on what really matters - exploring San Francisco's Golden Gate Park!

Golden Gate Park is hands-down one of the best places to ride in San Francisco with so many places to see, from museums and to gardens to a herd of lazy buffalo. Inside this 1000+ acre park, riders will see the Arboretum Botanical Gardens, Japanese Tea Gardens, Hippie Hill, the Bison Paddock and so much more!

We offer bikes for everyone, including eBikes, Kids Bikes and Tandems. Additionally, we have baby seats and baby trailers available for families.

---

**Tour Times:**
2PM Daily

**Pricing:** 
Adults - Starting at $45 | Children - Starting at $40

**Tips**
Dress appropriately  for the weather and don't forget your camera!
data.cancellation_notes:
**Bike Tour Cancellation Policy**

Please notify us at sales@unlimitedbiking.com at least 24 hours in advance if you cannot make your tour. Cancellations made 24 hours in advance get a full refund!

For any cancellations within 24 hours of the tour, we can provide a full credit in the amount you have paid towards bike rentals that will never expire!

Please note: If you reschedule your booking for a later date, we must receive your cancellation request 24 hours before your original travel date. If you reschedule for an earlier date, the 24 hour cancellation window applies to your new travel date.
data.booking_notes:
Thank you for booking a **Golden Gate Park Highlights Bike Tour** with Unlimited Biking! 
We are excited to have you join our amazing tour guides on an adventure through San Francisco's Golden Gate Park! This tour is approximately 2 hours long and covers all the must-see sights! 

Please try to arrive 10-15 minutes before your tour's starting time to check in with our team and meet your guide! Your outfit should be seasonally suitable; we also suggest that you dress in something comfy, not too loose, and closed-toe shoes. Don't forget a proper ID and your camera!


Tour departure location: [1792 Haight St San Francisco, CA 94117]


---

##Know Before You Go:
- All children must be *one year or older* to be on any bike/bike attachments.
- Any riders who are under 18 years of age must have an adult present to check in and sign the waiver form in behalf of them. We require a valid identity card upon check in.
- For all our riders' safety, we are not able to accommodate any riders who are 300 pounds and over as this exceeds the weight limit the manufacturer has advised for the bike's build. We apologize for the inconvenience, but we do prioritize your safety during the ride. 

If anything from the list above concerns you or any members of your party, please feel free to reach out to our team by responding to this email. We will get back to you as soon as we can!
